purpose.zh-Hant: 把移動條件翻成幾何集合，再檢查交點與端點限制。
purpose.en: Translate moving-point conditions into geometric sets, then check intersections and endpoint restrictions.

prerequisites.zh-Hant: 距離、中點、中垂線、角平分線及圓。
prerequisites.en: Distances, midpoints, perpendicular bisectors, angle bisectors and circles.

scopeNote.zh-Hant: 本頁提供基本方法導讀及現有題庫入口；進階分支與完整圖解會繼續補充，並非完整課綱或全章筆記。
scopeNote.en: This is a foundational method guide and an entry to the published bank. Advanced branches and complete visual explanations are still being developed; this is not a complete syllabus or chapter note.

title.en: Translate a moving-point condition into a set

intro.zh-Hant: 軌跡是所有符合條件的位置。P 到固定點 O 的距離為正數 r，形成以 O 為圓心、r 為半徑的圓。
intro.en: A locus is the set of all positions satisfying a condition. A point P at a fixed positive distance r from O traces a circle centred at O.

trigger.zh-Hant: 先寫誰是固定、誰在移動，以及距離是相等、固定還是成比例。
trigger.en: Identify the fixed objects, the moving point, and whether distances are equal, fixed or in a ratio.

trap.zh-Hant: 只有符合全部條件的位置才保留；r=0 時退化成單一點。
trap.en: Retain only positions satisfying every condition. For r=0 the locus degenerates to one point.

intro.zh-Hant: 到兩個不同固定點等距，軌跡是連線的中垂線。到兩相交直線等距，軌跡是兩條角平分線；到兩平行直線等距，則是中間平行線。
intro.en: Equidistance from two distinct points gives their perpendicular bisector. Equidistance from two intersecting lines gives both angle bisectors; for two parallel lines it gives the parallel line midway between them.

trigger.zh-Hant: 把「到點」與「到直線」分開；到直線的距離一定沿垂直方向量度。
trigger.en: Distinguish point distances from line distances. Distance to a line is measured perpendicularly.

trap.zh-Hant: 相交線的等距軌跡有兩條角平分線；題目限制角域時才取相應部分。
trap.en: There are two angle bisectors for intersecting lines. Restrict the locus only when the question restricts the region.

intro.zh-Hant: 若 PA 垂直 PB，P 在以 AB 為直徑的圓上，但 P 不能等於 A 或 B，否則夾角沒有定義。多個條件要取軌跡交集。
intro.en: If PA is perpendicular to PB, P lies on the circle with diameter AB, excluding A and B where the angle is undefined. Multiple conditions require intersecting loci.

trigger.zh-Hant: 先各自找軌跡，再解交點，最後逐點代回原條件並排除端點。
trigger.en: Find each locus first, solve their intersections, then check every candidate against the original conditions and excluded endpoints.

trap.zh-Hant: 距離平方或代數化可帶來退化或多餘候選；線段限制不能當作整條直線。
trap.en: Squaring distances or algebraic conversion can introduce degenerate or unwanted candidates. A segment restriction is not a whole line.
